districts.name: Downtown Metropolis
districts.theme: Glass skyscrapers, financial towers, media headquarters, and crowded avenues.
districts.description: The bustling heart of Metro Nova. High public visibility, massive comic press exposure, but bank heists and hostage crises are frequent.

districts.name: The Iron Docklands
districts.theme: Heavy industrial shipping yards, rusting cranes, cargo warehouses, and shadowy docks.
districts.description: A hotbed for arms smuggling, illicit tech trafficking, and brute mob enforcers.

districts.name: Neon District
districts.theme: Cyberpunk glow, holographic billboards, underground clubs, and high-tech black markets.
districts.description: Vibrant nightlife paired with data heists, neural hacking, and flashy rogue turf wars.

districts.name: Gothic Quarter & Asylum
districts.theme: Victorian gargoyles, mist-draped alleys, ancient cathedrals, and the maximum-security Blackgate Asylum.
districts.description: Occult rituals, supervillain breakout attempts, and psychological terror lurk behind every foggy corner.

districts.name: Aero-Tech Research Park
districts.theme: Clean minimalist science campuses, fusion generators, cleanrooms, and orbital transport pads.
districts.description: Frequent target of corporate espionage, high-end power prototype thefts, and rogue AI meltdowns.

districts.name: Subterranean Underbelly
districts.theme: Abandoned subway tunnels, radioactive runoff conduits, toxic subterranean bunkers.
districts.description: The lawless subterranean frontier where mutated renegades and exiled supervillains build doomsday machines.

rebuilding_sites.description: Repair structural steel spans damaged during heavy battle with supervillains.
Cleanse contaminated runoff tanks following arms syndicate clashes.
Restore emergency trauma center serving low-income families and asylum staff.
Reboot fiber-optic relays disrupted by cybernetic EMP grenades.
